name: a poem describing

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Hermetic seal of the glass vessel (The Admonitio).

VINIT.justification: The unformed, un-named ground before the alchemical riddle is set.

TANCH.justification: The final completion and closure of the Magnum Opus described in the poem.

AFWD.justification: The upward transformation of the volatile serpent toward the King's crown.

AREV.justification: The necessary descent and decay into the black earth to regenerate life.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chain of the Green Lyon devouring the Sun to produce the Gold.

IMSCRIB.justification: The serpent biting its own tail; the self-contained identity of the work.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the singular Stone into the Red King and White Queen.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the King and Queen into a singular, hermaphroditic whole.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative presence of the contrary that serves the King's health.

EVALF.justification: The obstructive failure or toxicity that must be overcome in the crucible.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradoxical 'Both' state where Mercury is simultaneously volatile and fixed.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible recording of the secret formula into Rawlin's poem.

phase_3.void_description: Pre-alchemical chaos; the vacuum of the unheated alembic.
phase_3.true_description: Gold; the successful transmutation and spiritual health.
phase_3.false_description: Divergent dross; the failure of the mixture.
phase_3.both_description: The Rebis; the state where opposites are held in a single body.

steps.domain_action: The prima materia enters the glass before the flame is lit.
The vessel recognises itself as the sole domain of the work.
The first line of the Ænigma is carved, fixing the intent.
The fire is applied, initiating the ascent of the volatile spirits.
The heat divides the matter into the polarity of King and Queen.
The Red King is recognized as the affirmative target.
The King grows in strength through repeated distillations.
The shadow (negation) is manifest as the Red Servant's contrary nature.
The Servant descends to the bottom to wash the King's feet (putrefaction).
The moment of the total eclipse where King and Servant are indistinguishable.
King and Queen are fused into the one body of the Rebis.
The Rebis is linked to the next stage of the Green Lyon's hunger.
The stone recognizes its own perfection and self-sameness.
The vessel is sealed, the riddle solved, the poem ended.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Alchemical Master (Rawlin) translating secrets into figures.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The heat of the furnace facilitating communication between elements.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The recurring symbols (Lyon, King, Queen) stored in the MS 3643.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The celestial alignment and the requisite 40 days of heating.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Hermetic Tradition and the Emerald Tablet.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The slow consumption of the coal in the furnace.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Disordered base metals and a hidden riddle.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The Stone and a transcribed solution.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The total matter in the sealed vessel remains constant throughout the transmutation.
